title: Token health prober and SLI synthesis canvas for proactive failover
creator: Aisha Rahman
description: Build a lightweight, low-cost synthetic probing system that measures token-level latency and error characteristics along realistic token paths and synthesizes a Token Health Index (THI) for each region/shard. The prober should: 1) emit golden signals (latency percentiles focused on per-token p50/p95/p99, error rates, and admission/eviction ratios) at token granularity; 2) group probes into cohorts (sequence-length tier, model-family, priority path); 3) feed a synthesis pipeline that computes a rolling THI per tenant/region and surfaces degradation causes (KV miss, kernel slowdown, queueing); 4) provide a dashboard canvas with triage panels and actionable thresholds used by circuit-breaker and failover orchestration. This ticket covers prototyping the probe harness, the SLI schema, ingestion pipeline mapping, and the initial dashboard buildout. Trade-offs: sample density vs cost, probe realism vs isolation, and use of eBPF vs SDK-based timing.
comments: 2026-02-25 - Kickoff: scoped MVP as 3 cohort probes (short/medium/long sequences) + THI calculation. Agreed to keep probe QPS low (0.1 qps per shard) to limit cost.
2026-02-28 - Design review: PM asked that THI include both relative latency degradation and absolute tail thresholds. Decided THI=weighted(1 - latency_score, error_score, admit_score).

2026-03-03 - Engineering update: implemented SDK-based microprobe and canonical probe payloads. Initial probes instrumented via tracing headers. Observed additional 0.8ms overhead; flagged for investigation.
2026-03-05 - Infra note: ingestion schema mapped to existing golden-signals pipeline; added th_tag and probe_cohort fields. Opened GH issue to add token_index histogram bucketization.
2026-03-07 - UX sync: draft dashboard panels include Token Health trend, cohort waterfalls, top contributing spans, and auto-generated playbook links for THI drops.
2026-03-09 - Blocker: regional synthetic IPs need allowlist for private deployments. Raised dependency on infra ticket ENG-902358 for network allowlist rollout.
2026-03-10 - PR 142 landed for probe agent; dashboard prototype deployed to staging. Plan: run 72h of probes and evaluate noise baseline before enabling automated failover triggers.
decisions: Use SDK-based probes for MVP to reduce rollout friction across Dedicated and Private deployments.
Token Health Index (THI) will be normalized 0-100 and computed every 30s with exponential decay to emphasize recent behavior.
acceptance_criteria: Probe harness runs in staging and emits token-level latency and error metrics with the agreed ingestion schema.
THI calculation is implemented in the streaming pipeline and produces a per-region, per-tenant timeseries with documented formula.
Grafana canvas shows THI + cohort breakdown and links to the playbook templates for escalation.
Automated test verifies probe QPS and that probes can be disabled per-tenant to avoid billing surprises.
Operational runbook created describing how to interpret THI drops, how to manually trigger a regional failover, and contact points.
